title: Zephyrine and the Signal
author: Edmund Ravensworth
blurb: Isandro Pemberton, the last human technician on an automated relay station, has spent five years hauling cargo through contested orbits. Then a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise before the jump window closes.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
